source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The news callback changes every non-success result except NS_ERROR_ABORT to NS_ERROR_FAILURE with postFailed text. Fixed source retains that mapping using send-error-post-failed. The callback then enters the shared delivery presentation path. Abort bypasses this conversion. This is a deliberate result translation in the checked implementation, not proof that original news-specific failure results are preserved or that an NNTP send succeeded. Source only: Bug 783526 comment 14 is unavailable; reviews are unread. No runtime validation.
title: Keep the NNTP generic-failure mapping separate from abort
